name: Grid Zoom
description: Image grid where clicking a cell zooms it into a detail view with animated text, a back arrow, a mini grid and top and bottom neighbor previews, while other cells fade out.
contents: Grid of image cells placed by column and row
Detail panel per item with number, heading, text and link label
Back arrow, mini grid switcher and previous and next image previews
behavior: Hover scales the cell down while the image inside scales up
Click zooms the cell to the right side of the viewport and fades the other cells with a staggered wave
Detail text reveals line by line with a sliding mask
Mini grid switches between items without returning to the grid
Back arrow returns to the grid, window resize keeps the zoomed cell aligned
Side previews and mini grid are hidden below 768px

props.name: fontFamily
props.default: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

editableByProps: All item images, numbers, headings, texts, preview images and grid positions
Colors, font, radius, grid spacing and row height
Hover and zoom scales, durations, zoom target position and stagger
Toggle mini grid and side previews

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the number of grid columns
needsCodeEdit.where: grid grid-cols-4 class on the grid div

fixed: Detail panel is a fixed full-viewport overlay while mounted
Grid uses 4 columns, item col values must be 1 to 4
Loads the Inter font stylesheet link into document head
Mini grid and side previews are hidden below 768px
